description: The Sauna Pod 2.4 × 1.9 m is the smallest outdoor sauna in the range: one room for 2–4 people, 44 mm pine walls, 2.6 m high, bitumen-shingle roof, two tempered double-glazed windows and an 850 × 1920 mm door. €3,896, delivered to the UK, Ireland and Europe. Where it fits. A corner of a small garden, a terrace, a glamping pitch or a holiday let. The footprint is under 5 m². On site. A level, dry base (paving slabs or a small slab), clear vents and the distances in the heater manual. An electric heater needs a qualified electrician. Need a changing room or space for more people? See barrel saunas and cabin saunas. Prices explained: garden sauna costs.
